name: dogfood-lemon-squeezy-app
description: Dogfood app v1.23-4 — a SvelteKit + Lemon Squeezy Merchant-of-Record RP that exercises hosted checkout + license key issue / activation / revoke + refund (full + partial) + chargeback dispute (opened + evidence + won / lost) + webhook signature verify (X-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body). Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Lemon Squeezy sandbox + LEMONSQUEEZY_KEY env-gate) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-lab/payment createLemonSqueezyMock + 8 axis semantics) so behavioural fidelity feeds the release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/payment -F @kiwa-lab/core build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
